name: com.faolline.graphimport
description: Generates com.faolline.graphquest, com.faolline.graphgameflow, and com.faolline.graphdialoguesystem assets from structured external data (CSV/JSON tables, or a dedicated dialogue interchange format), through declarative mapping and a pure plan-then-apply pipeline. No source table shape or column naming is assumed for quest/flow data; only the pivot's own domain model (quest/step/branch/reference, or dialogue/line/choice/end/sub-dialogue) is opinionated.
